# Synthetic HFA/EANT fixtures

These two compact `.ovr` files are deterministic parser/writer regression data,
not ERDAS IMAGINE-produced files. Their construction, evidence boundary,
verified structures, and limitations are documented in
[`docs/TEST_FIXTURES.md`](../../docs/TEST_FIXTURES.md).

Regenerate intentionally from the project root with:

```bash
python tests/fixtures/build_synthetic_ovr.py
```

The test suite compares regenerated bytes with the committed fixture binaries.
Do not replace these files with third-party OVR examples unless their
redistribution rights are established.
